messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India (as of 2026)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Official launch status** | Tesla has **not yet launched** the Model S (or any other vehicle) in India. The company’s first official entry into the Indian market is expected sometime in 2027‑2028, pending regulatory approvals and local manufacturing plans. | | **Estimated retail price (if launched)** | Based on current import duties, taxes, and the U.S. MSRP, analysts estimate a **price range of ₹1.5 – 2.0 crore** (≈ $200 k–$260 k). This includes:
• Base Model S (Long‑Range) – ₹1.5–1.7 crore
• Plaid variant – ₹1.8–2.0 crore | | **Key cost drivers** | • **Import duty**: 10 % on the vehicle’s value + 15 % on the engine (total 25 %)
• **GST**: 28 % on the combined value
• **Cess & other levies**: 3 % on the vehicle’s value
• **Logistics & handling**: 1–2 % of the vehicle’s value | | **Why the price is high** | 1. **High import duties** on electric vehicles in India. 2. **Limited local production** – until Tesla builds a Gigafactory in India, all units will be imported. 3. **Premium positioning** – the Model S is a luxury flagship with advanced tech. | | **What to watch for** | • **Government policy changes**: India has been discussing reducing EV import duties to boost local manufacturing.
• **Tesla’s local manufacturing plans**: If Tesla builds a factory in India, the price could drop significantly (potentially 30–40 % lower).
• **Currency fluctuations**: The INR/USD exchange rate can affect the final price. | ### Bottom line - **No official price yet** – Tesla hasn’t launched the Model S in India. - **If/when it does launch**, expect a price in the **₹1.5–2.0 crore** range, subject to changes in duty structure, local manufacturing, and currency movements.
